Prompt.Prompt: EF-REG-022 - Over-threshold submission creates one linked approval task

parameters.script: const text=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245'; const task='101661275'; const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes(key)); return {href:location.href,descriptionCount:(text.match(new RegExp(key,'g'))||[]).length,taskCount:(text.match(new RegExp(task,'g'))||[]).length,cardCount:cards.length,cards:cards.map(t=>t.slice(0,900)),freshExpenseCount:(text.match(/EXP-1039/g)||[]).length};

parameters.elementDescription: The 'Open expense' link inside the only EFREG022-ApprovalLink-EFQA-20260925T1245 card in the CENTER area, below the approval reason and above the decision buttons; it is paired with EXP-1039 and Task #101661275, not the adjacent EFREG023 card.
